description: Interaction patterns used for puzzle/skill segments. Multiple can be picked per project. Defaults pull from the 11 recipes in server/data/minigame_recipes.seed.json — custom recipes only when none fit.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}
And these prior picks:
{prior_picks}

Generate {count} minigame options. PREFER existing recipes from the seed catalog when they fit the style guide. Each option must use at least one of: crank, accelerometer, sprite collision, timing window.

Existing recipes (set recipe_kit_id to one of these and leave custom_recipe_spec null):
- crank_lockpick
- tilt_maze
- rhythm_crank
- dialog_wheel
- character_creator_crank
- conveyor_sort
- wave_defense
- code_lock_combo
- memory_recall
- top_down_explore
- side_scroll_platform

If and only if no existing recipe fits, set recipe_kit_id='custom' and supply a full custom_recipe_spec (premise, features_used, controls, state, sample_structure) matching the recipe shape used in minigame_recipes.seed.json.

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the minigame option below per the user feedback. Prefer swapping to a different existing recipe; only emit a custom recipe if none fit.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.recipe_kit_id: string — one of: crank_lockpick, tilt_maze, rhythm_crank, dialog_wheel, character_creator_crank, conveyor_sort, wave_defense, code_lock_combo, memory_recall, top_down_explore, side_scroll_platform, or 'custom'
